title: Origin story: Spider Grandmother
description: Spider Grandmother, Kokyangwuti, is the earth goddess of Hopi tradition who helped create the world and taught the people weaving. She sits at the center of the web of life, advising heroes and gods alike, spinning the threads that connect all living things.

title: Ability profile: Spider Grandmother
description: Ranked abilities: Weaving — rank 100/100; Patience — rank 99/100; Wisdom — rank 98/100; Counsel — rank 97/100; Creation — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Spider Grandmother
description: Powers: The web connecting all life; Creation's original patterns; Wisdom sought by gods and heroes.

title: Stamina feats: Spider Grandmother
